title: BUGFIX — daily-engagement.ts: filter test/E2E users from active user list
rationale: logs/achiri-daily-engage-error.log shows 400 'chat not found' errors for e2e-test-1773963856108, e2e-safety-..., validate-sprint-..., etc. The daily engagement script reads daily-counts.json which includes all users ever processed — including synthetic test IDs injected by validate-e2e-alpha.ts. Telegram sendMessage fails for these non-existent chat IDs. Fix: in getActiveUsers(), skip users whose ID does not match the numeric Telegram chatId pattern (/^-?\d+$/).

tasks.description: In scripts/achiri/daily-engagement.ts getActiveUsers(): after building the users Set, filter to only keep user IDs that look like real Telegram chatIds (numeric, optionally negative for groups). Add: const REAL_USER_REGEX = /^-?\d+$/; and filter the returned array. Add a console.log for skipped non-numeric IDs so the log shows how many test users were excluded.
